description: Removes the background from one image with BackGone’s production engine and returns a transparent PNG (or WebP) inline. Without a key it runs the free trial: 2 images per day per IP, free-tier 1024px output, never charged. With "Authorization: Bearer sk_..." it costs 1 API credit per successful image at full resolution (failed calls are not charged); the first key includes 15 free API calls, top up at https://backgone.com/pricing. Provide exactly one of image_url or image_base64.

format.description: Output format. PNG is the default; WebP is smaller and capped at a lower megapixel limit.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (PNG, JPEG or WebP; up to 10 MB). A data: URL prefix is also accepted. Use this when the image is local to the agent.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. Fetched server-side with SSRF protection.

name: remove_background
title: Remove an image background
